name: Glass Shatter
description: Voronoi facets with stress birefringence: residual stress concentrates at the facet boundaries and under load, and the resulting retardation produces per-wavelength polariscope fringes along the cracks. Crack energy accumulates in dataTextureC so repeated clicks progressively craze the glass rather than each producing an isolated ring. Fixes a mask-as-colour hazard where dataTextureA held a mask tuple that nothing read, and adds ACES in place of a hard clamp.
